Program Description

Upon successful completion of the Pre-master’s in Business, Economics and Finance, students can proceed to study for a postgraduate degree at the University of Glasgow. The course length of the pathway is determined mainly by the student’s English language level (UKVI IELTS score or accepted equivalent).

All students take a set of common or similar modules to gain key skills for university. If a student’s course is longer than 2 terms, the student will take extra modules focusing on one or more of English language, academic skills and basic subject knowledge.
